tasks.title: Future you
tasks.starter:
age = int(input())
future_age = age + 5
print("In five years:", future_age)

hints.spaces: The comma adds the space after the colon. Don't add another.

tasks.title: Double trouble
tasks.starter:
number = ___(input())
doubled = number ___ 2
answer = doubled ___ 10
print("Double it and add 10 gives", ___)

hints.error: Replace every ___ first. Line 1 needs int, * means times, and you print the variable answer.
hints.other: Check each step: int() first, then * 2, then + 10, then print answer.

tasks.title: Tuck shop
tasks.starter:
money = int(input())
price = int(input())
print("Your change is", change, "pounds")

hints.error: Python doesn't know change yet. Before the print line, make the box: change = money - price.
Did you use int(input()) for both numbers?
hints.other: Adults cost 8 each and children 5 each: adults * 8 + children * 5.
